sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS all_rows, SUM(CASE WHEN case_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND case_date < DATE '2026-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS calendar_2025, SUM(CASE WHEN case_date IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_dates, MIN(case_date) AS min_date, MAX(case_date) AS max_date FROM MONTGOMERY_READY.code_violations_2025
SELECT geoid, tract_name, population, code_violations_2025, violations_per_1000 FROM MONTGOMERY_READY.tract_violations ORDER BY violations_per_1000 DESC LIMIT 5
